annotations.title: Connect a monitor to an action

description: Connects a monitor's change_detected event to an action: action='notify' (channels and recipients the account has configured), 'workflow' (runs a saved workflow), or 'ai_task' (an AI agent opens the page and works `prompt`). A price watch takes `threshold` (+ threshold_op): the action then runs once, when a check reads a price at or below it. Buying at a price (`buy`): writ_help('writ_wire_monitor').

buy.description: Run the workflow or task as a purchase (saved as a rehearsal until armed).

threshold.description: Price watch: act once when the price reaches this number.

name: writ_wire_monitor
